import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]

    min_wins = 0
    min_wins += max(0, a[0] - b[0] - b[2])
    min_wins += max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1])
    min_wins += max(0, a[2] - b[1] - b[2])

    max_wins = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
    print(f"{min_wins} {max_wins}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
